dct_description_sm: This dataset contains two CSV files. One file contains beetle sampling data, and the other file contains the guild associated with each beetle species sampled. Data supports research on the effects of different silvicultural treatments and type of retained legacy trees in managed mixedwood stands on beetle communities.
dct_title_s: Harvest intensity and legacy trees shape beetle species assemblages in Quebec’s temperate mixedwood forests 10 years after logging
